metrics.label_policy: demo_v1: rating >= 4.2 AND positive_ratio >= 0.75 AND (rating_count >= 3 OR delivered_units >= 3); rule-generated labels, not independently observed popularity
metrics.validation_note: Holdout measures agreement with supplied labels; demo labels do not validate real-world popularity.
metrics.tree_rules:
|--- rating <= 4.10
|   |--- class: 0
|--- rating >  4.10
|   |--- rating_count <= 2.50
|   |   |--- class: 0
|   |--- rating_count >  2.50
|   |   |--- positive_ratio <= 0.71
|   |   |   |--- class: 0
|   |   |--- positive_ratio >  0.71
|   |   |   |--- class: 1
